THINGS_CHROMATIC_FISSION_POWER.title: Chromatic Fission
THINGS_CHROMATIC_FISSION_POWER.descripti:
When HP drops to half or below, its next move becomes [gold]Split[/gold] into [blue]2[/blue] smaller [gold]Chromatic Slimes[/gold] with its remaining HP.
Large splits by trigger: Attack pushing [blue]5[/blue]+ past half spawns [gold]Crimson[/gold] + [gold]Azure[/gold]; under [blue]5[/blue] spawns [gold]Amber[/gold] + [gold]Crimson[/gold]; non-Attack spawns [gold]Azure[/gold] + [gold]Amber[/gold] ([gold]Crimson[/gold] attacks, [gold]Amber[/gold] gains [gold]Block[/gold], [gold]Azure[/gold] inflicts [gold]Slimed[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold]).
THINGS_CHROMATIC_FISSION_POWER.smartDesc:
